cands.bio: Small business owner and community advocate in Calhoun County, Alabama. Her campaign site lists her as Executive Board President of 2nd Chance, a domestic violence shelter. She was the Democratic nominee for Alabama House District 40 in 2022 and 2026 and lost both times. She has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists her as recommended in three voter-guide groups, all of the "Sway voting group" type: Tabitha's List, The Neighborhood Guy's Candidates Jamboree, and Unburdening The Ballot.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Pam Howard was born or raised, or how old she was when she came to Calhoun County in 1996. We could not find what her business does or her work history beyond that. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Her campaign site states priorities on education, healthcare, jobs and veterans, but we found no stated position on data centers, property taxes, growth and land, guns, abortion, immigration, or policing. She has held no office, so there is no record of actions in office.

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 40 since November 2022. U.S. Navy veteran. Co-owns Heflin Fitness and Lineville Fitness. Has served as executive director of the Cleburne Chamber of Commerce.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Robertson was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no documented bills he sponsored, since the sponsored-legislation list in the page we read was empty. We found no stated positions on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no notable endorsements, controversies or foreign ties.
